channel.title: Members on Hagrou
channel.description: Recent content in Members on Hagrou

item.title: Alice
item.description: An introvert who loves words that reflect the world; I listen to them and play with them passionately… before recharging my batteries by reading in the garden in a pink sequinned skirt, (poorly) hidden behind large sunglasses.

item.title: Charlotte
item.description: I’m Tiago’s foster mum, in love with Florent, and a French teacher; I love spending time with my family and friends. I also enjoy reading, going to concerts, watching films and plays, going for walks, cycling, soaking up the sun, strolling around Brussels, and discovering a new beer or a new park (this list isn’t exhaustive).

item.title: Florent
item.description: I particularly love my family, my friends, beer and drawing… In that order.

item.title: Geoffrey
item.description: A cheerful thirty-something, I love making my friends and family laugh. A weekend sports enthusiast who enjoys both getting away from it all and literary exploration, I love spending time with people over a beer in a pub. A video editor by trade, playing video games, role-playing or watching films are some of my little pleasures. I’m very curious by nature and love organising and taking part in all sorts of activities. An extrovert with a slightly shy streak, Team ENM, feminist, ally and LGBTQIA+ friendly, ️I also share a flat with my cat Mike.

item.title: Hicham
item.description: My three key traits: enthusiasm, nuance and jokes. And board games. And cycling. And loads of other stuff, actually. Oops… Can I still add more things? There’s no character limit, right? Because I’ve just thought of something I hadn’t mentioned yet…

item.title: Isabelle
item.description: Sunday 26 April 2026, 2.03 pm: In 27 minutes, I have to set off for the Hagrou meeting. Settled comfortably on my yellow sofa, I’m waiting for a fascinating fun fact about myself to surface in my mind. A gentle breeze caresses my cheek. My eyelids feel heavy and the soft purr of engines below lulls me. My eyes are closing… Come on, just a few minutes…

item.title: Marika
item.description: After two years in Brussels, where I joined Hagrou, I’ve been in Montpellier since mid-2026, where I continue to be part of the adventure remotely. I enjoy cultural outings, board games, travelling by train to visit my friends, I do dance classes and my goal this year is to keep my plants alive!

item.title: Nicolas
item.description: I’ve been trying to set up a co-housing scheme for 10 years now; we’re almost there – as an architect, I’ll finally be able to design the project of my dreams! Which will definitely include a dance floor!

item.title: Romain
item.description: It was a series of happy coincidences that brought me to Belgium and then into this group, and I’m delighted to be building these relationships with my future neighbours. I’m fascinated by everything to do with games and group dynamics. I win and lose arguments – not particularly important ones, mind you – but I do so with conviction when it comes to the names of the working groups within Hagrou.

item.title: Simon
item.description: Dad of three, games enthusiast, artist, queer and climber. I tend to be either on a rock, in my kitchen or, let’s be honest, behind my computer tinkering with my latest project. Whether it’s a new city in Anno, a novel or my next role-playing session… If we go by what people say about me, I’m quirky, kind and very uncompromising when it comes to the rise of fascism!
